name: @resumekit/static
description: Resumekit's templates rendered to static HTML at build time: a self-contained Node module and the pruned stylesheets the pages need.
author: Starlin Gil Cruz

scripts.build: vite build && tsc -b tsconfig.lib.json && tsx --conditions=@resumekit/source scripts/build-static-css.ts
scripts.check:package: rm -rf out-tsc/pack && pnpm pack --pack-destination out-tsc/pack >/dev/null && publint --strict --pack pnpm && attw out-tsc/pack/*.tgz --profile esm-only --exclude-entrypoints ./templates.css ./package.json
